dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple interlocking 'O' and 'C' shaped structures across the lateral flank. Perimeters consist of thin, high-intensity white-to-gray jagged lines transitioning abruptly to a dark charcoal-colored interior. One prominent closed 'O' structure mid-lateral exhibits a pixelated boundary with a high-contrast gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, high-intensity white pixel clusters located on the dorsal surface near the neck region. Core concentrations are asymmetrical, appearing as scattered stippling that lacks internal gradients between the larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli—one located near the posterior flank, one mid-lateral, and one adjacent to the anterior flipper—form an elongated, obtuse scalene triangle oriented along the longitudinal axis of the torso.

other_distinctive_markers: Five distinct, elongated, dark-toned ungual processes (claws) are visible on the distal margin of the pectoral flipper.
